_note: Deploy values only. Program id comes from the IDL (target/idl/safu_pool.json `address`); every rule number comes from the IDL constants. `siteRpcPath`: the deployed site reads the chain through the claim API (/rpc, server-side provider failover); `rpcUrl` is for tools and local dev. `crankMinLamports`: the server only counts matured backing of at least this much (smaller amounts: the backer presses, so dust cannot spend the server's fee money). Marinade PDAs are derived from `marinade.state` with the seeds in pool-core/src/marinade.rs.
